dispositions.community_noop_and_overwrite: Replaced duplicated resolver with shared resolve_knockouts; validate before baseline solves and combine records before GPR. Four new community methods and full nearest gate pass.
dispositions.ambiguous_labels: Loader now initializes every gene ID first, then rejects conflicting declared labels. Duplicate-label and label-ID collision subtests pass.
dispositions.other_modification_transactionality: Not expanded. Scope and docs promise validation of all knockout identities before bound changes, not atomicity for all malformed non-knockout modifications.
dispositions.masked_target_deletion: Public masked problem already rejects original target aliases and direct MASKED_TARGET condition deletions. Unknown other condition genes now fail before solving.
dispositions.positive_controls: Native positive capacity, preserved growth, deletion zeros, no-growth maintenance capacity and carbon infeasibility now asserted with unchanged original protocol bounds. Added after initial diagnostic, labelled developmental checks.
dispositions.restored_arm: Renamed native_repeat and documented state-isolation/determinism control, not complementation.
dispositions.oracle_scope: Independent parser/GPR/bounds/solver; shares declared protocol assumptions. No empirical medium truth or congener mapping is claimed.
dispositions.curated_metadata: Explicit manual-curation provenance, checked phrases/units and paragraph hashes; all24cells retained; genotype population checked.
dispositions.primary_chemical_mapping: No congener-level experimental evaluation. Review speculates about mass mapping; not adopted as a verified chemical identity or total-titer comparison.
dispositions.label_effect_on_real_model: Added label-only derived SBML fixture, identical stoichiometry/bounds/GPRs; two before-failing/after-native-ID-equivalent capacity checks.
